meta.title: JEE coaching for Class 11 in Pune | D-SAP Ghule
meta.description: A two-year JEE Main and Advanced programme from Class 11, for students who passed Class 10 from any board. Evening classes in Pune.

h1: JEE coaching for Class 11 in Pune

intro.text: The two-year programme starts in June after Class 10, with a foundation period from April. It runs through Class 11 and Class 12 and prepares for both JEE Main and JEE Advanced.

sections.heading: Who it is for

body.text: Students who have passed Class 10 from any board: SSC, CBSE or ICSE.

body: Starting in Class 11 gives two full years for a syllabus that covers both Class 11 and Class 12.

body.text: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics, to the level of JEE Main and JEE Advanced.

points.text: Theory notes for every chapter, with solved examples.
Chapter-wise problem sets at Main and Advanced level.
Past IIT JEE papers with full solutions.

body.text: Classes run from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}, after school, on AI-powered digital boards.
Doubts go to the doubts forum or a doubt session, and students can book one-on-one time with a teacher in mentoring slots.
Lectures are also online, so a missed class can be watched again.
A test after every chapter, and a longer test every fourth week. Weekly tests switch between one topic and the full syllabus so far. Once a month there is a full JEE Main mock.
In Class 12, a JEE Advanced mock is added every quarter. Every test is taken on the online portal and comes back with a personal analysis.
